How Are Artificial Body Parts Made? Korea’s Amazing Technology for Replacing Missing Parts

Hello, this is King Process.
How are artificial body parts that replace human eyes, hands, legs, and teeth made?
In this video, we introduce four manufacturing processes, from artificial eyes carefully handcrafted by a specialist with 40 years of experience to prosthetic hands and legs made using 3D technology and durable Korean dental implants recognized around the world.
Different materials and techniques are used for each product, including artificial eyes with hand-painted blood vessels and iris colors, prosthetic hands and legs shaped to fit the human body, and dental implants that require exceptional strength and precision.
Watch the detailed process behind Korea’s artificial body parts, carefully made to replace missing parts of the human body.
